content: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
themes: sadness, grief and a broken heart, feeling crushed or depressed, comfort and closeness when hurting, being rescued, safety in sorrow

content: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
themes: fear and anxiety, feeling afraid or unsafe, choosing trust over fear, safety, courage when threatened

content: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
themes: fear and dismay, feeling weak and unsafe, being strengthened and helped, not facing it alone, safety and support

content: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
themes: trouble and crisis, needing a refuge and shelter, safety and strength, help when overwhelmed

content: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
themes: the darkest valley, fear of danger or death, depression, comfort and protection while suffering, safety, not walking alone

content: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
themes: fear of other people, courage and confidence, safety and security, light in the darkness, strength, no need to be afraid

content: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time; casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
themes: worry and anxiety, heavy burdens and stress, handing your cares over, being cared for, safety and relief, humility

content: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
themes: healing a broken heart, emotional wounds and hurt, sadness, being restored and bandaged up, worth and being cared for

content: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
themes: self-worth and self-esteem, feeling worthless or not good enough, being wonderfully made, thankfulness for who you are

content: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
themes: worth and value, feeling unimportant or overlooked, being known and counted, you matter more than you think, fear of insignificance

content: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you; therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.
themes: feeling unloved, rejected or worthless, being precious, honored and loved, worth, self-esteem

content: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
themes: being loved and delighted in, worth, calm and quiet love, God present with you, joy sung over you, comfort for anxious or sad hearts

content: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
themes: exhaustion and burnout, heavy burdens, depression and weariness, rest for the soul, gentleness, relief from pressure

content: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
themes: freedom, feeling controlled, trapped or in bondage, autonomy, standing firm, not letting others control you

content: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
themes: making decisions, guidance when the path is unclear, uncertainty, trust, autonomy and choosing your direction

content: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
themes: feeling powerless, overcoming fear, power and self-control, courage, autonomy, inner strength, boundaries

content: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
themes: peace with other people, doing your part, healthy boundaries, conflict with family, friends or co-workers, resentment and anger, autonomy

content: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
themes: anger and arguments, calming a conflict, gentle words, answering without rage, tension at home or work

content: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger; for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
themes: anger, listening before speaking, patience, self-control, conflict, learning to control your temper

content: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
themes: anger and a quick temper, patience, wisdom and self-control, staying calm

content: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
themes: loneliness, belonging, family, being given a home and community, isolation and feeling left out

content: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
themes: loneliness and isolation, friendship and companionship, someone to lift you up when you fall, belonging, not facing it alone, working together with friends or co-workers

content: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
themes: friendship, loyalty in hard times, friends and siblings who stand by you, belonging, family support

content: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
themes: fear of being abandoned or left behind, contentment with what you have, never forsaken, belonging, not being alone

content: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.
themes: abandonment or rejection by parents and family, estranged family, belonging, being taken in and cared for

content: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
themes: feeling orphaned or abandoned, loneliness, belonging, not being left alone, loss of family

content: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from God’s love, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
themes: nothing can separate you from love, belonging and security, feeling cut off or rejected, fear of death or loss

content: Rejoice always. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
themes: gratitude and thankfulness, joy, rejoicing always, giving thanks in every situation, prayer, happiness

content: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
themes: joy in today, gladness, gratitude for this day, celebrating, happiness

content: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.
themes: thankfulness for goodness and lasting kindness, gratitude, praise, happiness

content: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God, and knows God.
themes: love for one another, connection with family, friends and neighbors, loving relationships, happiness in community

content: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
themes: unity and harmony, family and friends living together in peace, connection, happiness in togetherness

content: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
themes: empathy, sharing in other people's joy and sorrow, connection with friends and family, so that no one weeps alone, compassion

content: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
themes: friendship that makes you better, encouraging each other, connection with friends and co-workers, learning from one another, growth

content: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
themes: hope for the future, purpose and plans, feeling lost or unsure what comes next, peace, discouragement and depression

content: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
themes: purpose and calling, being made for a reason, meaningful work, doing good, worth

content: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men, knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
themes: purpose in daily work, co-workers and bosses, working wholeheartedly, finding meaning in your job, resentment at work, reward for faithful effort

content: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
themes: plans and purpose, uncertainty about the future, trusting a bigger plan, humility, guidance

content: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
themes: abundant life, fullness of life, flourishing, being protected from what steals joy, abundance

content: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
themes: provision, having enough, needs being met, financial worry, abundance, trust that you will be supplied

content: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
themes: lacking nothing, contentment, being guided and provided for, abundance, trust, peace and security

content: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
themes: abundance, sufficiency, having enough to give generously, generosity, grace overflowing, doing good
